description: NSIRA found that prior to reforms in August 2018, a mandatory CBSA-developed indicator used by IRCC for Iranian applications was based entirely on Iranian nationality combined only with age and sex. Applicants matching it were automatically referred to CBSA and CSIS.
energy_note: Screening triggered by demographic category, not by conduct.
notes: This is the strongest single citation in the whole dataset for the 'Iranian + male' intersection. Read the full summary before relying on it.

description: The government abandoned mandatory indicators in 2018 over concerns about efficacy and the delays they caused - not, on the record, over discrimination.
NSIRA noted IRCC did not record which indicator triggered a referral. An applicant therefore cannot establish why they were screened, which forecloses most avenues of challenge.
